outcome: Expression levels of genes related to nerve development and differentiation (Ntrk, Neuregulin 1, Neurogenin 1, Neurogenin 2)
cohort: The study participants were FGR model fetuses, prepared by ligating uterine arteries in mice, and control mice.
finding: Fetal growth restriction (FGR) in mice leads to decreased cardiac autonomic control (reduced STV), delayed neural differentiation (altered gene expression), and a significantly increased risk of cerebral hemorrhage when exposed to hypoxic load resembling labor.
